class Setup < Gtk::Builder
        CATEGORIES = {} unless defined?(CATEGORIES)
        CATEGORIES.merge!({
          general: {
            repository: {
              default: [],
              load: proc do |store, setting|
                store.clear
                setting.each do |item|
                  votes = item[7].to_i.positive? ? item[7] : ''
                  rating = item[7].to_i.positive? ? "#{(item[6].to_f / item[7].to_f).to_s.slice(/^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9])?/)}" : ''
                  downloads = item[5].dup.to_i > 999 ? item[5].dup.reverse!.gsub!(/(\d{3})(?=\d)/, '\\1,').reverse! : item[5]

                  iter = store.append
                  iter[0] = item[0] # filename
                  iter[1] = item[1] # game
                  iter[2] = "#{(item[2].to_f / 1024).to_s.slice(/^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9])?/)}k" # size_show
                  iter[3] = item[2].to_i # size_sort
                  iter[4] = Time.at(item[3].to_i).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") # last_updated
                  iter[5] = item[4] # author
                  iter[6] = downloads # DLs_show
                  iter[7] = item[5].to_i # DLs_sort
                  iter[8] = rating # ratings_show
                  iter[9] = rating.to_f # ratings_sort
                  iter[10] = votes # votes_show
                  iter[11] = votes.to_i # votes_sort
                  iter[12] = item[8] # tags
                  iter[13] = item[9] # comments
                end
              end
            },
            search_entry: { default: '' },
            download_link: { default: '' },
            link_data: { default: '' }
          }
        })

        def self.get_category(key)
          CATEGORIES.each { |category, data| return category unless data[key].nil? }
          nil
        end

        def self.get_setting(key)
          cat = get_category(key)
          return nil if cat.nil?

          CATEGORIES[cat].each { |setting, data| return data if setting == key }
          nil
        end

        def initialize(repo_list)
          return unless defined?(Gtk) && Gtk::Version::MAJOR == 3

          super()

          @running = true
          @repo_list = repo_list

          # Remove the first element (header)
          @data_without_header = @repo_list[1..-1]

          # Sort the array by the first element of each subarray
          @data_without_header = @data_without_header.sort_by { |subarray| subarray.first.downcase }

          Gtk.queue do
            add_from_string(self.class.repository_ui)
            load_settings

            self['main'].show_all
            self['main'].keep_above = true
            self['main'].set_title "Repository Search"

            connect_signals { |handler| method(handler) }

            # Access the GtkSearchEntry widget
            search_entry = self['search_entry']

            # Connect signal to handle search entry text changes
            search_entry.signal_connect('changed') do
              search_text = search_entry.text
              filter_data(search_text)
            end

            # Connect signal to handle search activation (e.g., pressing Enter)
            search_entry.signal_connect('activate') do
              search_text = search_entry.text
              filter_data(search_text)
            end
          end

          wait_while { @running }
        end

        def load_settings
          Gtk.queue do
            objects.each do |obj|
              next unless obj.methods.include?(:builder_name)

              key = obj.builder_name.to_sym
              setting = self.class.get_setting(key)
              next if setting.nil?

              case obj
              when Gtk::Label
                self[key].visible = false if key == :link_data
              when Gtk::Button
                if key == :download_link
                  self[key].signal_connect("clicked") do |button|
                    link = self['link_data'].text
                    next if link == 'label'

                    # Disable briefly so a double click doesn't start a duplicate download
                    button.sensitive = false
                    @pending_link = link
                    GLib::Source.remove(@download_timer) if @download_timer
                    Script.start('repository', link, force: true)
                    @download_timer = GLib::Timeout.add_seconds(10) do
                      @download_timer = nil
                      @pending_link = nil
                      button.sensitive = true if @running
                      false # one-shot timer
                    end
                  end
                end
              when Gtk::Entry
                obj.text = ''
              when Gtk::TreeView
                store = self["#{key}_store"]
                if store.nil?
                  respond "** failed to find store for treeview #{key}"
                  next
                elsif setting[:load].nil?
                  respond "** no :load defined #{key}"
                  next
                end

                setting[:load].call(store, @data_without_header)

                self[key].signal_connect('row-activated') do |_, path, _|
                  iter = self["#{key}_store"].get_iter(path)
                  self['comments'].text = iter[13]
                  self['download_link'].label = iter[0]
                  self['link_data'].text = "download #{iter[0]} --author=#{iter[5]} --game=#{iter[1]}"
                  # Stay disabled if this is the script that was just downloaded
                  self['download_link'].sensitive = self['link_data'].text != @pending_link
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def filter_data(search_text)
          search_text.downcase!
          filtered_data = @data_without_header.select do |item|
            item.any? { |column| column.to_s.downcase.include?(search_text) }
          end

          # Reset comments box and download button
          self['comments'].text = ''
          self['download_link'].label = 'Download selected script'
          self['download_link'].sensitive = true
          self['link_data'].text = 'label'

          # refresh the GtkTreeView using the load proc
          CATEGORIES[:general][:repository][:load].call(self[:repository_store], filtered_data)
        end

        def on_close_clicked
          self['main'].destroy
        end

        def on_destroy
          # Already on the GTK thread; set immediately so pending download timers see it
          @running = false
        end

sail2.source: if script.vars[1] =~ /^config$/i $sail2_config_window = nil GLib::Idle.add do begin data = load_sail2_data use_flag = data.fetch("use_flag", true) flag_mode = data.fetch("flag_mode", "white").to_s.downcase $sail2_config_window = Gtk::Window.new $sail2_config_window.title = "Sail2 - Flag Configuration" $sail2_config_window.set_default_size(320, 200) $sail2_config_window.set_border_width(16) $sail2_config_window.keep_above = true $sail2_config_window.signal_connect("destroy") { $sail2_config_window = nil } outer = Gtk::Box.new(:vertical, 12) $sail2_config_window.add(outer) # Header header = Gtk::Label.new header.set_markup("Sail2 - Flag Settings") header.set_halign(:start) outer.pack_start(header, false, false, 0) outer.pack_start(Gtk::Separator.new(:horizontal), false, false, 2) # Use flag checkbox use_flag_cb = Gtk::CheckButton.new("Change ship flag when sailing") use_flag_cb.active = use_flag outer.pack_start(use_flag_cb, false, false, 0) # Flag color row color_row = Gtk::Box.new(:horizontal, 8) color_lbl = Gtk::Label.new("Flag color:") color_lbl.set_size_request(90, -1) color_lbl.set_halign(:start) color_row.pack_start(color_lbl, false, false, 0) color_combo = Gtk::ComboBoxText.new ["white", "black", "neutral"].each { |c| color_combo.append_text(c.capitalize) } color_combo.active = ["white", "black", "neutral"].index(flag_mode) || 0 color_row.pack_start(color_combo, true, true, 0) outer.pack_start(color_row, false, false, 0) # Grey out color combo when use_flag unchecked color_row.sensitive = use_flag use_flag_cb.signal_connect("toggled") { color_row.sensitive = use_flag_cb.active? } outer.pack_start(Gtk::Separator.new(:horizontal), false, false, 2) # Buttons btn_box = Gtk::Box.new(:horizontal, 8) btn_box.set_halign(:end) outer.pack_start(btn_box, false, false, 0) save_btn = Gtk::Button.new(label: "Save") save_btn.signal_connect("clicked") do d = load_sail2_data d["use_flag"] = use_flag_cb.active? d["flag_mode"] = ["white", "black", "neutral"][color_combo.active] || "white" save_sail2_data(d) respond "--- Sail2: Flag settings saved. use_flag=#{d["use_flag"]} flag_mode=#{d["flag_mode"]}" end btn_box.pack_start(save_btn, false, false, 0) close_btn = Gtk::Button.new(label: "Close") close_btn.signal_connect("clicked") do Gtk.queue do $sail2_config_window.hide $sail2_config_window.destroy end end btn_box.pack_start(close_btn, false, false, 0) $sail2_config_window.show_all rescue => e respond "--- Sail2 config GUI error: #{e.class}: #{e.message}" respond e.backtrace.first(3).join("\n") end false end # Keep the script alive until the window is closed wait_until { $sail2_config_window.nil? } exit end
